title: For the lake (not in the game yet)
note: Candidates for the lake level. Pick one of the two lake tunes (only one fits the game's 4 MB sound budget), and say whether the lapping water and the loon are right. Both tunes are set to the grove music's loudness and go round without a gap.

sounds.label: Lake music A: Down the river
sounds.what: A warm, gently adventurous acoustic tune with banjo, 1 minute 17 seconds, that goes round without a gap.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Down The River" by Loyalty Freak Music (Komiku), from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Lake music B: Morning Sky
sounds.what: A calm, bright morning tune, 2 minutes 12 seconds, made by its composer to go round without a gap.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Morning Sky" by Centurion_of_war, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Water lapping at the shore
sounds.what: Small waves lapping at a river pier, 5.6 seconds that go round without a gap, to play quietly by the water.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Sea and river wave sounds" by RandomMind, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: A distant loon
sounds.what: A loon's wail far across the water, with the lake's echo, to play now and then. Made in code by this project: no CC0 recording of a loon could be found (the one on OpenGameArt is CC-BY-SA, which this game does not use).
sounds.credit: Made by this project, in code. No credit needed.
